speakers.name: The Undertaker
speakers.comment: Nothing goes under glass until somebody certifies which decade it belongs to. I approve entirely. In my trade we ask far less and mount them all the same, and I have long suspected we get it wrong about twice a season.

speakers.name: The Three Little Dead
speakers.comment: Dusk and dawn, they answer — no, they only answer, they don't reply, that's different — a hundred clicks all at once and one of them is the year. We asked about the wolf. They told us a Thursday. We are still cross.

speakers.name: Perrin Voss
speakers.comment: Every verse I copy is different by morning. I have stopped treating that as damage and started treating it as the text. The god is not being unclear. The god is answering a slightly different question each night, and I keep asking.

speakers.name: Riff the Forgewright
speakers.comment: NO HUMMING THE SECOND VERSE! Do you hear that, friend? A rule against a TUNE! Somebody down there learned the hard way that a melody is a load-bearing structure and I have never respected a seminary more!

speakers.name: Grudge Fenrik
speakers.comment: Moon comes down close enough to seed us every single night and the settlement calls that a harvest. It is not a harvest. It is a sowing, and we are the field, and we have got very good at pretending those are the same word.

speakers.name: Little Miss Thorn
speakers.comment: You mustn't touch a bloom that pulses along with your heart. Mama would say that is a very sensible rule. Cordelia says it is a rule about ownership, and that if the pulse matches, one of you already belongs to the other.

speakers.name: Rook Calloway
speakers.comment: Every bowl tastes like a fate that was meant for somebody else. That is not a flaw in the recipe, that is the recipe. Somebody, somewhere, is having a very ordinary evening because a stranger ate their good one at my counter.

speakers.name: The Magpie
speakers.comment: Ooh — you must let the luck settle in the bowl before you eat! Shine of nine, that rule. Everybody watches the broth and nobody watches the cook, and the cook is the only one who knows which way the settling goes.

speakers.name: Vex Thistlewick
speakers.comment: The spine grows a new ring every season and it grows them out of us. Cheerfully: nobody aboard has volunteered. I have rubbings going back four decades and there are memories in there that no living crew member can account for.

speakers.name: Kaz the Kaiju-Spotter
speakers.comment: Okay so the goblins read the RINGS, like actual tree rings, except each one is a whole season of what the ship remembers — I have logged eleven and one of them has a gap in it and NOBODY will tell me what got spliced out

speakers.name: Coral Vey
speakers.comment: The yard regrows what drowned and everyone tells me that is only metal doing metal things. Then why does the pulse-metal flinch at the same hour every night. Something in here remembers being built. I intend to find out by whom.

speakers.name: Sister Feedback
speakers.comment: You do not mend what can knit itself. A scar hums, flushes pink and closes over by morning — that is not repair, congregation, that is devotion performed by the wound. The metal suffers beautifully and asks nothing of us.

speakers.name: Thess Marrow
speakers.comment: Pirates came for the ending of a song and I came for the voice inside it, and we are all in the same sunk opera house pretending those are different errands. My mother is in the third act somewhere. Play quietly.

speakers.name: Kaz the Kaiju-Spotter
speakers.comment: Nobody is ALLOWED to finish the last aria and that is the most exciting rule I have ever written down! Something enormous is listening for the final note. I want to see it. I have a whole page ready for it.

speakers.name: Bailiff Ashorn
speakers.comment: The hedges remember everyone who passed and I read them for a living, and my own recollection is borrowed from the same green. So I check the wall, then I check myself against the wall. The theft happened. That much both agree on.

speakers.name: Pixl
speakers.comment: They grow the case files! You can't cut a page out, you have to go and READ IT where it LIVES, which — b-but that means the archive keeps growing after the verdict, which means the file knows things the judge didn't

speakers.name: Marlow Fenn
speakers.comment: The dogs know before the body does. That is the checkpoint in one sentence and it is why my sector reports zero. They clear the not-yet as living, because they are, and I sign it, because they are. Ask me again in a week.

speakers.name: Gary the Walrus
speakers.comment: Barrier hums violet, dog does the nose thing, line moves. Eleven years of that. People come through expecting a moment. It is a queue. Bring a jumper; the amber glass does nothing for the wind.

speakers.name: Corra Finnwake
speakers.comment: The runway lights stay on for anybody who has not landed, which means they will never go out, which means somebody decided a long time ago that the airfield would rather be wrong than give up. I write to him under them.

speakers.name: Little Miss Thorn
speakers.comment: Never taxi past the third spire after dark. What a polite way to say it. Cordelia and I counted the spires from the window and there were four, and in the morning there were three again, which we thought was very good manners.

speakers.name: Applause
speakers.comment: THE DEAD ARE WALKING AND THEY ARE WALKING IN A LINE, do you understand what that IS? A catwalk needs an audience and I have never once seen a crowd this committed to staying! Sew faster, darling. Sew faster.

speakers.name: Reginald Brushtail
speakers.comment: Nine tails and a crown you have not grown into — friend, I know that weight to the ounce. Trick them if you must; the woods forgive a clever ruler faster than a heavy one. But go to the shrine first. Go before you are asked.

speakers.name: Sweet Tooth
speakers.comment: Oh, they sent you to fetch a child and they did not tell you why, and now you are standing in a village doorway with your hands out. I know that doorway. Whatever you do next, do it before the mother offers you tea.

speakers.name: The First Draft
speakers.comment: You are already falling so the planning stage is OVER, which is the best possible news — no wait, it's the only news, that's better. Grab something. Anything. Fix it on the way down. That's how I got here and I am doing FINE.
